selection: All complete promotion-journal records at one frozen read-only prefix, no kind/outcome/score filtering. Plot counts per wall-clock hour in fixed six-hour bins anchored at earliest logged event timestamp, ending at capture time; distinguish ordinary promotion and historical admission kinds, retain zero-count bins, expose/mark partial final bin and its exact duration. Preserve every event timestamp/round/kind/source-line SHA in public identity-free lineage CSV; raw records private. State journal-record coverage and source populations, not proposal success, writer learning or serving throughput.
derivation: All timestamps parsed to integer UTC microseconds. Fixed six-hour left-closed bins anchored at minimum event timestamp; final right edge is capture time and inclusive. Counts include every complete source record exactly once. Rates are count*3600000000/exposure_us using Decimal precision28; float conversion only for rendering.
scope: Adaptive training-side program-pool journal additions, ordinary promotions distinguished from historical admissions. Clock exposure includes work, waits and gaps; zero bins mean no journal additions. Not attempted proposals, adapter admissions, model updates, serving throughput, stable-population comparisons or learning gains. Exact loop/population/normalization qualification remains separate.
